MapContext.addMarkers(Object object)

Add a marker.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
markers Array Yes Same as the marker attribute of the transferred map component
clear Boolean false No Whether to clear all markers on the map first
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function for interface invoking failure
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

//maml
    <button bindtap="addMarkers"> addMarkers</button>

//js
Page({
  data: {
    markers: [
      {
        id: 0,
        title: 'marker0',
        latitude: 31.984686,
        longitude: 118.574979,
        width: 10,
        height: 15,
        anchor: { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 },
      },
    ]
  },

  addMarkers() {
    let markerArr = [
      {
        id: 2,
        title: `marker2`,
        latitude: 32.130366,
        longitude: 118.995885,
      }
    ];
    this.setData({
      markers: markerArr,
    });
    this.mapContext.addMarkers({
      markers: markerArr,
      clear: true,
      success(res) {
        ma.showModal({
          content: res.errMsg,
        });
      },
      fail(res) {
        ma.showModal({
          content: res.errMsg,
        });
      },
    });
  },
});
